|strategy=By Ryan Werntz, Red 13<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20010321011721/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/premiere/light/small/wioslea.html</ref>

Not only does [[Wioslea]] have a great deploy to power ratio, she has a destiny of 5 which fits right into an insert based deck. Deploy her at the [[Cloud City: Incinerator]] and couple her with [[Spaceport Speeders]] and an [[R2-X2 (Artoo-Extoo)]] and you have a great combination which allows you to activate a lot of Force without losing any cards. Place her in a [[Cloud City Sabacc]] based deck and you have a gambler and a great draw during Sabacc games.

Combos:

[[Wioslea]] + [[Cloud City: Incinerator]] + [[Spaceport Speeders]] + [[R2-X2 (Artoo-Extoo)]] - to create a great Force generator!

[[Wioslea]] + [[Cloud City Sabacc]] - to help you win Sabacc games!

A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (the stat boxes and the deploy and forfeit numbers) with its corrected game text, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its ''Decipher Errata'' sheet dated 1 March 2017 (the PDF was made on 31 May 2017).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-L-wioslea-PC-Errata-2017-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Wioslea (PC Errata 2016 disc card)]] (6 August 2016): Same words as the previous version. The slip shows only the lower part of the card and adds a white italic “E” at the lower right. The slip replaces the full card image.

Lower part of the previous card image (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2017 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
